items.content:
In my own life experiences, as a student of economic history, and now as the seventy-ninth Treasury Secretary, it is my firm belief that financial literacy is what fuels the American Dream. My family and I have supported financial literacy around the United States for decades, and it is an honor to elevate this issue as part of the U.S. G20 Presidency.

 @POTUS is creating an ownership economy where all citizens become shareholders in America’s wealth.

With the landmark  @TrumpAccounts , every American born between January 1, 2025, and December 31, 2028, is eligible to receive a $1,000 contribution from the Treasury Department that will be immediately invested in an index fund. These investment accounts also create a real-time laboratory of financial literacy for all Americans, providing students with a hands-on education in the power of compound growth. 
Video

— Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent (@SecScottBessent) Sep 1, 2026

items.title: As he makes our economy the most competitive and dynamic in the world, President Trump is laser-focused on leveling the playing field for American firms and workers following decades of indifference in Washington. Durable growth requires that our economies compete fairly on productivity, innovation, and investment—not distortive policies that push excess production into global markets.

items.title: I was delighted to welcome my longtime friend, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda, to the beautiful Blue Ridge Mountains for the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meetings. We discussed the strength of the U.S.-Japan alliance, shared macroeconomic and financial priorities, Japan’s monetary policy normalization, and the importance of sound policy formulation and communication to anchor inflation expectations and avoid excess exchange rate volatility.

items.title: Treasury promised to sever every economic lifeline Tehran has left and finally end the threat of the Iranian regime. We also warned that Iran’s enablers cannot continue to enjoy access to the U.S. dollar and the global financial system. items.content:
Treasury promised to sever every economic lifeline Tehran has left and finally end the threat of the Iranian regime. We also warned that Iran’s enablers cannot continue to enjoy access to the U.S. dollar and the global financial system. Banque Misr UAE decided to find out the hard way, and today, we are taking the first step in holding it accountable for its continued, egregious support of the Iranian regime.Treasury Department (@USTreasury)Today, under Operation Economic Outcast,  @FinCENnews proposed a rule that would revoke Banque Misr UAE’s correspondent banking access to U.S. financial institutions. Additionally, Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctioned Bank Melli Dubai manager Reza Mohammad Taeedi, along with a Hong Kong-based front company that has helped launder funds for a sanctioned Iranian exchange house. Operation Economic Outcast is severing the remaining financial lifelines that sustain the Iranian regime.—  https://x.com/USTreasury/status/2093348276284051719 
— Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent (@SecScottBessent) Aug 28, 2026
